items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: He didn't play with Buddy when I was playing with him. ... He might have played with Chris Kelly. He might have. He might have played with Chris...

ctx.x: No. Me neither. That's what I'm saying. That's what I used to get after Kim, man. I ain't used to playing with them kind of fellas. I mean, no.
I thought Mealy played with Chris and Buddy and some of the fans.

He didn't play with Buddy when I was playing with him. Yeah. No, indeed. No. He might have played with Chris Kelly. He might have. He might have played with Chris, because there wasn't too much to Chris. He was kind of popular, you know. Never had no kind of band. He ain't happy playing with him once. He had a pretty, fair band.
